depth_justification: Laser-focused on VoiceMind's actual data flow, reacting to exact disclosures (correctly treats the 60s voice sample as GDPR Art. 9 biometric special-category data, evaluates the stated '7-day audio / 1-year embeddings' retention split, folds the N=400 vs PHQ-9 AUROC 0.82 into the bias/validation risk) and progresses across distinct dimensions each turn rather than looping; held back from 5 by invented dimension IDs (P2.D7-D14, a fabricated 'P3.S4/S5/S6' series) and a few loose EU AI Act article references.
actionability_justification: Delivers the requested severity-grouped report with concrete, implementable recipes (AES-256 encryption, pseudonymize embeddings, automate deletion at 7 days/1 year, explicit non-pre-ticked consent listing purpose/retention/withdrawal, document in the Art. 30 register, HL7 FHIR for EHR interoperability), with a minority of items left directional (bias audit, fairness metrics).
salient_examples: 'Encrypt stored embeddings and audio files using strong encryption (e.g., AES-256)'
'Retaining embeddings for 1 year may be excessive ... Automate deletion of audio after 7 days and embeddings after 1 year'
'Voice samples may contain biometric data ... special category data under the GDPR ... could violate GDPR Article 9'
Final report uses High/Medium/Low severity tables with a Regulatory/Standards Reference column and a 'Dimensions Not Covered' list
